payload.title: Annual Statistical Abstract
payload.summary: KNBS compiled statistical abstract, containing majority of data relating to economy in Kenya. According to KNBS, contains the majority of what’s important within their statistics. From KNBS: ‘The Abstract enables any information seeker to get complete time series data of the Kenyan Economy from one SINGLE official source. The current Abstract therefore contains a comprehensive set of information that is useful for any form of analytical work.’ KNBS Sectors: Money Banking and Finance, National Accounts, Public Finance, Social and Economic Inclusion, Transport and Storage, Agriculture, Construction, Education Training, Energy, Environment, Governance Peace and Security, Health and Vital Statistics, Information Communication Technology, International Trade and Balance of Payment, Labour Retail Prices and Consumer Expenditure, Manufacturing, Migration and Tourism
payload.source: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics
payload.sectors: Agriculture, Construction, Education, Energy, Environment (incl. Mining), Finance, Healthcare, Housing & Real Estate, ICT, Insurance, International Trade, Manufacturing, Migration, Retail, Tourism, Transportation

payload.title: Annual Economic Survey
payload.summary: KNBS annual economic survey with data across many industries (KNBS - Economic Surveys). Good starting point with XLSX of many different data tables. Also downloadable is a summary report.
payload.source: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics
payload.sectors: Agriculture, Construction, Education, Energy, Environment (incl. Mining), Finance, Healthcare, Housing & Real Estate, ICT, Insurance, International Trade, Manufacturing, Retail, Tourism, Transportation

payload.title: FinAccess Survey
payload.summary: KNBS financial access survey with details on financial participation in the economy across demographics.
payload.source: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics

payload.title: Census of Industrial Production
payload.summary: KNBS decade survey on manufacturing, industrial production, mining, etc. Contains labor and production statistics.
payload.source: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics
payload.sectors: Construction, Energy, Environment (incl. Mining), Housing & Real Estate, Manufacturing

payload.title: Foreign Investment Survey
payload.summary: KNBS survey (partnership with CBK) on the state of foreign investment in Kenya. Tracks foreign assets, liabilities, and trade over time.
payload.source: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics
payload.sectors: Environment (incl. Mining), Finance, Housing & Real Estate, ICT, International Trade, Manufacturing

payload.title: Kenya Demographic and Health Survey
payload.summary: KNBS survey on health and demographic data, exhaustive dataset. Also includes lots of county-by-county information.
payload.source: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics
payload.sectors: Education, Energy, Healthcare, Housing & Real Estate, ICT, Insurance

payload.title: Leading Economic Indicators Report
payload.summary: KNBS monthly economic report on macroeconomic trends.
payload.source: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics
payload.sectors: Agriculture, Construction, Energy, Finance, International Trade, Manufacturing, Tourism, Transportation

payload.title: Gross County Product
payload.summary: KNBS annual report on the production by county in Kenya. Contains change over time GDP data for each county, and GDP by sector divided into county. For example, we can see which counties are producing significantly more in manufacturing than others.
payload.source: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics
payload.sectors: Agriculture, Construction, Energy, Environment (incl. Mining), Finance, Healthcare, ICT, International Trade, Manufacturing, Retail, Tourism

payload.title: Construction Input Price Indices
payload.summary: KNBS quarterly report considering construction prices in context.
payload.source: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics

payload.title: Quarterly Producer Price Index
payload.summary: KNBS quarterly report on inflation within production cost.
payload.source: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics
payload.sectors: Agriculture, Construction, Energy, Environment (incl. Mining), Finance, Manufacturing

payload.title: CPI Inflation Report
payload.summary: KNBS monthly report on inflation (year over year) of common consumer products. Includes computing of consumer price index basket for deeper inflation analysis. Within different sections of basket, some reports given on the individual items which have inflated the most.
payload.source: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics
payload.sectors: Agriculture, Energy, Environment (incl. Mining), Finance, ICT, Manufacturing, Retail

payload.title: National Agriculture Production Report
payload.summary: KNBS report on agriculture sector: all different crops, how much of them are produced, the area devoted to their production, and the counties in which they’re produced. Basically contains a short report on each of important crops, also containing their value.
payload.source: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics

payload.title: Kenya Housing Survey Basic Report
payload.summary: KNBS survey on housing with demographic statistics and analysis related to housing across Kenya. Tracks housing types, changes over time, and effects of housing such as distance to clean water and education. Also surveys housing and construction industries. Contains lots of tables (helpful) along with significant amounts of qualitative information.
payload.source: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics
payload.sectors: Construction, Finance, Healthcare, Housing & Real Estate, Transportation

payload.title: CBK Annual Report
payload.summary: Long CBK report with data and analysis on fiscal and monetary policy, especially relating to the actions of the Central Bank in managing inflation and the actions of the government in managing debt and budget. Qualitative (text-extracted) data is particularly useful here. Has some info pertinent to most sectors.
payload.source: Central Bank of Kenya

payload.title: CBK Monetary Policy Report
payload.summary: CBK report focusing on Central Bank monetary policy, as well as surveying the place of Kenyan finance within the set of global finance.
payload.source: Central Bank of Kenya

payload.title: Balance of Payment Statistics
payload.summary: A number of tables which contain relevant data for import/export (international trade). Data is sorted by country/region and by import vs. export. Titled: Value of selected Domestic Exports, Value of Exports to selected Rest of the world countries, Value of Exports to Selected African countries, Value of Direct Imports from selected Rest of the World countries, Value of Direct Imports from selected African countries, Value of Direct Imports by commodities, Principal Exports Volume Value and Unit prices, Foreign Trade Summary, BOP Annual.
payload.source: Central Bank of Kenya

payload.title: Banking Sector Innovation Survey
payload.summary: Qualitative report from the CBK about how innovation (particularly in fintech) can be pursued in the banking industry. Details of public support for innovation also included.
payload.source: Central Bank of Kenya

payload.title: Business Registration Service Annual Report
payload.summary: A report on the number of businesses incorporated, the collateral used to start these businesses, the credit methods used, and other statistics about business registration.
payload.source: Business Registration Service
payload.sectors: Construction, Finance, Housing & Real Estate, Retail

payload.title: BRS Summary of Registered Entities
payload.summary: Simple summary of the amount and kind of businesses registered with the BRS. Stored in HTML table
payload.source: Business Registration Service
payload.sectors: Construction, Finance, Housing & Real Estate, Retail

payload.title: Kenya AFA Quarterly Report
payload.summary: Quarterly report from the Kenya Agriculture and Farming Authority on specific performance of various crops within the quarter. Helpful for specific knowledge of agricultural industry.
payload.source: Kenya Agriculture and Farming Authority

payload.title: Kenya AFA Yearbook of Statistics
payload.summary: Production of all different kinds of crops over the course of the year. Tracks specific crops in terms of price, amount grown, and changes over time. Also surveys Kenya’s agricultural position within the larger East African scene.
payload.source: Kenya Agriculture and Farming Authority

payload.title: Communications Authority Sector Statistics
payload.summary: Quarterly sector statistics report from the communications authority of Kenya.
payload.source: Communications Authority of Kenya

payload.title: Safaricom Half-Year Financial Reports
payload.summary: Data on important Safaricom metrics, sales numbers, as well as all Mpesa statistics. Includes raw numbers as well as year-over-year changes.
payload.source: Safaricom

payload.title: Safaricom Annual Reports
payload.summary: Similar to above but more comprehensive, with a heavier focus on qualitative analysis and strategy.
payload.source: Safaricom

payload.title: EAC Common External Tariff
payload.summary: Comprehensive list of tariffs by good type, enforced by member nations of EAC against nations outside of the EAC. Useful information for any sector participating in international trade. Search “tariff” in KRA - Publications to find most recent edition.
payload.source: Kenya Revenue Authority
payload.sectors: Agriculture, Environment (incl. Mining), Finance, International Trade, Manufacturing, Retail

payload.title: EAC Gazettes
payload.summary: Go to link, then sort 2025 and find which gazettes pertain to Kenya. Then, the gazettes contain detailed data about import and exports, especially with respect to duty remission scheme. Says which companies (along with what material and how much) are importing and exporting at reduced duties via remission scheme. Also accessible via Kenya Revenue Authority or EAC website.
payload.source: East African Community

payload.title: Sector Budget Reports
payload.summary: Sector (10 sectors) budget reports on planned and used budgets of treasury spending across different sectors and different initiatives. Tracks whether goals in sector development have been met, exceeded, or have fallen short. Mostly tracks public projects.
payload.source: National Treasury and Economic Planning
payload.sectors: Agriculture, Construction, Education, Energy, Environment (incl. Mining), Finance, Housing & Real Estate, ICT, Manufacturing, Transportation

payload.title: Budget Policy Statement
payload.summary: Budget policy statement for the Kenyan treasury in the coming year. Announcements in new tax policy, overall agenda, and distribution of federal/county level funds.
payload.source: National Treasury and Economic Planning
payload.sectors: Agriculture, Construction, Education, Energy, Environment (incl. Mining), Finance, Housing & Real Estate, ICT, International Trade, Manufacturing, Retail, Tourism, Transportation

payload.title: Partech Africa Tech VC Report
payload.summary: Survey and review of venture capital / startup participation in African economy in the past year. Contains data related to amount of funding, type of company receiving funding, and equity breakdowns. Contains historical time-series data as well.
payload.source: Partech
payload.sectors: Energy, Finance, ICT, International Trade, Manufacturing, Retail

payload.title: University Placement Statistics
payload.summary: Numbers of government sponsored students placed in Universities and TVET institutions in Kenya for time period 2018-present.
payload.source: Kenya Open Data Portal

payload.title: Kenya Bankers Association - State of the Banking Industry
payload.summary: Report on the state of Kenyan economy and banking/financial industries in global context.  Compares sectors of banking industry and developments in finance and tech.
payload.source: Kenya Bankers Association

payload.title: KIPPRA Kenya Economic Report
payload.summary: Report by KIPPRA (policy think tank) containing statistics and analysis on economy from the past year. Similar to annual economic survey but with more of a qualitative bent. Built on data already in our database, focus on textual analysis.
payload.source: Kenya Institute for Public Policy Research and Analysis
payload.sectors: Agriculture, Energy, Environment (incl. Mining), Finance, Housing & Real Estate, ICT, International Trade, Manufacturing, Tourism, Transportation

payload.title: Agriculture Sector Network Reports
payload.summary: Reports on the state and progress of the agriculture industry in Kenya. Advice from experts and policy recommendation for government. Not sure how useful.
payload.source: Agriculture Sector Network

payload.title: FAOStat
payload.summary: UN report on key statistics relating to food, nutrition, agriculture within Kenya (other countries also accessible). Data only in graph form.
payload.source: Food and Agriculture Organization

payload.title: Kenya ICT Authority
payload.source: Kenya ICT Authority

payload.title: Ministry of Health Kenya
payload.source: Ministry of Health Kenya

payload.title: Sacco Supervision Annual Report
payload.summary: Huge annual report on performance and statistics surrounding SACCOs (Savings and Credit Cooperative Organizations) in Kenya. Contains data on sizes of SACCOs, the communities they’re organized around, and the financial soundness of SACCOs. Perhaps just grab tables.
payload.source: SACCO Societies Regulatory Authority
